projects.title: Airbnb Room Type Classifier
projects.category: ML Web App · Python · Scikit-learn · FastAPI · Render
highlights: Predicts whether an NYC Airbnb listing is an Entire home, Private room, or Shared room using listing details such as price, location, reviews, and availability.
Compared multiple classification models and tuned the best-performing model using RandomizedSearchCV.
Achieved 85.5% accuracy and 0.73 Macro F1 on 48,895 listings.
Deployed the trained ML pipeline through a FastAPI REST API with an interactive web interface.

projects.title: MindMetric AI — Student Mental Health Predictor
projects.category: ML Web App · Python · Scikit-learn · FastAPI · Render
highlights: Predicts a student mental health score from lifestyle, study habits, social media usage, sleep, and stress-related factors.
Built and tuned a regression pipeline using Random Forest, preprocessing, feature encoding, and scaling.
Achieved R² 0.87 with RMSE 0.49 on 5,000 student records.
Integrated the model with FastAPI + Pydantic and deployed a web application on Render.

projects.title: Employee Attrition Analysis
projects.category: Data Analytics · MySQL · Python · Power BI · DAX
highlights: Analyses employee data to identify why employees leave and which groups have higher attrition risk.
Used SQL and Python to clean, analyze, and segment 1,400+ HR records.
Built an interactive Power BI dashboard with DAX KPIs and dynamic filters.
Identified patterns across department, role, salary, tenure, age, and education.

projects.title: Retail Sales Performance Analysis
projects.category: Data Analytics · Python · Pandas · NumPy · Matplotlib · Seaborn
highlights: Explores retail sales data to understand product performance, customer segments, and sales trends.
Cleaned and transformed the dataset using Pandas and NumPy.
Performed EDA and statistical analysis to identify important sales patterns.
Created visualizations with Matplotlib and Seaborn to communicate business insights.
